label: H.R. 10760
title: Healthy Minds for a Better Future Act

items.snippet: This bill establishes the Middle School Mental Health Task Force at the Department of Education and the Department of Health and Human Services.

items.item: Department of Health and Human Services
items.snippet: This bill establishes the Middle School Mental Health Task Force at the Department of Education and the Department of Health and Human Services.
The task force must study and report on the resources that are available to secondary school educators and parents for helping students who are experiencing mental health issues.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

K000398.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
K000398.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
K000398.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
